defects.title: Insecure CORS configuration: wildcard origin with credentials enabled
defects.description: CORS sets Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true, which violates CORS spec. Browsers reject credentialed requests with wildcard origins, breaking frontend integration. Also allows arbitrary origins to make credentialed requests.
defects.recommendation: Replace wildcard origin with explicit allowed origin list (e.g., http://localhost:5173 for dev).

defects.title: Check-then-act race condition in Register with wrong error handling
defects.description: Concurrent registrations with same email: both requests pass FindByEmail check, first Create succeeds, second fails with unique constraint but returns 500 instead of detecting the constraint violation and returning 409.
defects.recommendation: Handle PostgreSQL unique_violation error code and return ErrEmailExists (409) appropriately.

defects.title: Config loaded before .env file parsing
defects.description: config.Load() at line 25 runs before loadEnvFile at line 73. The .env file specified as CLI argument has no effect on config since it is loaded after config is already resolved.

defects.title: log.Printf mixed with structured zap logger
defects.description: Uses log.Printf for warning message while rest of application uses structured zap.Logger.

defects.title: Inefficient regexp.MustCompile called on every function invocation
defects.description: regexp.MustCompile is called on every invocation of isValidPassword and extractNickname, causing unnecessary CPU overhead.
defects.recommendation: Hoist regexp.MustCompile calls to package-level variables.
